formal_definition.description: The complete formal CGT definition. 4-8 sentences. Integrates: what the pattern is ({label_name}), what it processes/resolves, properties and dimensions, conditions, relationship to core, and conceptual boundaries. Present tense, theoretical language.

core_essence.description: One-sentence distillation of what this category IS at its most abstract. The irreducible core of the pattern.

properties_integrated.description: All properties from the paradigm_state, integrated into the definition.

gradient.description: The documented gradient of this property.

integration_note.description: How this property is reflected in the formal definition.

evidence_strength.description: strong = both extremes well-documented. moderate = one extreme thin. thin = tentative.

structural.description: Stable contextual conditions that enable or constrain this pattern.

contingent.description: Variable circumstances that change how this pattern manifests.

relationship_to_core_category.description: How this category relates to the core category. E.g., 'is_a_strategy_for', 'is_a_condition_of', 'is_a_consequence_of', 'co-occurs_with', 'is_a_variant_of'.

relationship_rationale.description: Why this relationship type was assigned, citing evidence.

what_it_is_not.description: What this category explicitly does NOT capture. Prevents miscoding.

category_name.description: A category this one could be confused with.

key_difference.description: What essentially distinguishes this category from that one.

definition_confidence.description: How confident is this definition? high = all properties well-documented, clear positioning. medium = some properties thin. low = category still evolving.

pending_elaborations.description: What aspects of this category still need elaboration to strengthen the definition.
